messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: anomalous auth failure spike to auth-service (token-validate).  src: 54.210.*/16, pattern matches indexing-forwarder traffic. severity: high. link: https://pager.redwood/2800123456
Maria Chen (oncall): I'm up. Acknowledged. tagging SRE and Security.
Samir Patel: digging in logs now — runs look like high-volume POST /v1/token/validate with x-forwarded-for set to external indexer IPs.
Samir Patel: quick grep: 
```
# container auth logs
2026-03-18T11:04:12Z auth-service token=eyJ... user=svc-indexer env=prod src=54.210.12.45 status=200
2026-03-18T11:04:12Z auth-service token=eyJ... user=svc-indexer env=prod src=54.210.12.46 status=200
2026-03-18T11:04:13Z auth-service token=eyJ... user=svc-indexer env=prod src=54.210.12.47 status=401
```
Samir Patel: see repeated tokens and some 401s — suggests token reuse or leaked token fragments in logs/forwarders.
Lee Wong - Security: stop traffic to suspicious prefix at edge WAF, and pivot to blocking on ASN for now. Also request immediate rotation of indexer svc-account keys. Nora FYI (legal).
Maria Chen (oncall): ops-sre, can you enact WAF block and apply rate-limit rule? :eyes:
ops-sre: deploying WAF rule now: block 54.210.0.0/16, add rate-limit 100r/s on /v1/token/validate from unknown clients. ETA ~2m.
infra-bot: WAF rule applied (rule id waf-idx-2026-03-18-01).
Samir Patel: running targeted key rotation for svc-indexer — will create new short-lived key and push to indexer via vault. Running: 
```
/scripts/rotate_keys.sh --service svc-indexer --destination vault://prod/indexer --ttl 1h --force
```
Samir Patel: rotate script output: new key created (id idx-rot-2800), pushing to vault, revoking old key in 30s.
Samir Patel: revocation executed: old key marked revoked. Confirming auth requests drop to baseline.
Maria Chen (oncall): customer impact check: current 5% of production users hit transient 401s in EU region over last 3 minutes. No major errors persisted after rotation but some API calls failed.
Lee Wong - Security: call it a data-exposure suspicion: tokens appeared in observability-forwarder logs sent to external indexer. We need to open incident ticket and notify affected customers if token scope included customer data. Nora please advise on disclosure timeline.
Nora (legal): joining. Need inventory of what logs were forwarded (buckets, retention) and list of tenants present in those logs. If customer tokens were present, follow incident disclosure policy.
Maria Chen (oncall): created INC-2026-847 in incident tracker, set severity P1, assigned to Samir (SRE) and Lee (Security). short summary and mitigations recorded.
Samir Patel: follow-up tasks: 1) rotate any other svc keys that used same indexer pipeline 2) scrub logs from external indexer + request deletion 3) patch observability-forwarder to strip auth tokens from logs 4) add regression test for no-token-forwarding.
Lee Wong - Security: temporary mitigation accepted. Will schedule permanent fix: default redaction at edge + explicit allowlist for debug headers.
Maria Chen (oncall): thanks team. I'll stay on watch for 30m and then handback to daytime oncall. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, traffic blocked and keys rotated. monitor=active.
